text: The Patriots head into their Week 6 matchup against the Jets at Gillette Stadium on Sunday carrying some significant injury baggage alongside a burst of momentum: Drake Maye earned FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week honors after a dominant performance in the Raiders win, proving he's turned things around with his confidence and deep ball despite the team's mounting health concerns, while cornerback Christian Gonzalez declared himself ready to return after missing two games with a shoulder injury and wide receiver Brown has returned to practice. However, the offensive line took a hit with left tackle Will Campbell sidelined by an MCL sprain in his right knee, and running back TreVeyon Henderson faces multiple weeks out with a high ankle sprain, leaving New England to navigate its secondary and backfield depth charts while Maye attempts to build on his excellent week. The injury report and game preview will provide the full details on availability, but between Maye's recent flourish and the returns of Gonzalez and Brown, there's enough good news to offset the losses up front and in the backfield as the Patriots prepare to host New York.
